quest.title: Lionfang's Legacy
quest.description: Jack wants to search for Stanley's old weapons in secret, as they are the sword and shield passed down from the Lion of the South, and thus fascinate Jack greatly.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land

talks.objective: Search for the Sword of Brilliant Valor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, that bunch of hilichurls... are they holding some kind of ceremony?

talks.objective: Defeat the hilichurls conducting a ritual
Retrieve the Sword of Brilliant Valor

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Eh-he. Lo and behold, the <color=#00E1FFFF>Sword of Brilliant Valor</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure? Looks kinda basic to Paimon, and a little worse for wear too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why would hilichurls be bowing down before a piece of junk like this?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: (Ahh... Seems somebody tossed an old sword into a pile of spoils these hilichurls were already celebrating...)

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: This is in terrible shape! And it's so basic, I... I'm at a loss for words.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm... say, Jack, have you ever seen an Anemo Crystalfly? They're found in the open country around Mondstadt City.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: If you saw one in broad daylight, you wouldn't bat an eyelid. But in the pitch blackness of night? Its brilliant glow is mesmerizing — it truly resembles an exquisite crystal dancing in the night air.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Is valor not the same? When everything is going your way, it seems meaningless — fades into the background. But when you're in dire straits, valor is the thing that gets you fired up and fighting back. It's the brilliant ray of light that guides you out from the darkness.

choices.text: That was some very elaborate ox dung.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: You're right... you're right! Then this has to be it — this is the Sword of Brilliant Valor!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ehehe, mm-hmm! So, we got our sword — now we just need that shield!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Let's scout around! It's definitely in <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color> some— huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's somebody there!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Stanley? What's he doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's acting so weird...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: What happened? Why did you stop all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Huh? Oh, ah, it's nothing. Just one of those Mora-spouting weasel thieves passed by is all.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: What? Where? I wanna see!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Maybe another time, hehe. We have a shield to find, remember?

choices.text: Excellent recovery.
Almost fell for it myself!

talks.objective: Seek the Shield of Magnificent Honor
Cut a deal with the hilichurl

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Lo and behold, the <color=#00E1FFFF>Shield of Magnificent Honor</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Liar, liar, pants on fire! It's a chunk of wood!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A chunk of scrap wood with a handle attached... Who in their right mind would use this as a shield!?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: There's also wine stains on it... Yeah, I'm pretty sure this was just taken from a wine barrel...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: And yet, my bard's intuition tells me that this is none other than the Shield of Magnificent Honor.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Warriors wear their battle scars with pride, and shields are no different.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Surely, an intact shield is one that has shied away from the battlefield. Is not the broken and splintered shield the one that has fought in countless wars and lived to tell the tale?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Though the soldier's body be tired and torn, still they fight till the very end, till they have no blood left to bleed. Such magnificent strength of will... is that not the true meaning of honor?

choices.text: I agree with Venti!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You do have a point... Shiny new shields don't stay new and shiny for long...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay then... Well, maybe if we ask nicely, he'll just let us take the Shield of Magnificent Honor for free?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *clears throat* Excuse me, Mr. Hilichurl?

response.speaker: Hilichurl
response.text: Dala?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Welp! Okay, you take it from here, {NICKNAME}! Hope you've picked up some Hilichurlian by now. If not, there's always body language...

choices.text: I'll pay good Mora for that shield.

response.speaker: Hilichurl
response.text: Biadam!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh... He <color=#00E1FFFF>did not seem to appreciate</color> that.

choices.text: Please take this sweet flower I picked.

response.speaker: Hilichurl
response.text: Mosi mita!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems <color=#00E1FFFF>cheerful</color> enough. Maybe negotiating will work after all...

choices.text: Venti sing song, you give shield, okay?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hmm? Well, if you insist, a tune I shall strum...

response.speaker: Hilichurl
response.text: Mosi mita!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems <color=#00E1FFFF>cheerful</color> enough. Maybe negotiating will work after all...

choices.text: Please take this hilichurl mask I stole.

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Muhe vin plata? Mani ye! Mani dada!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! He actually gave us the shield!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Yaya ika! Kundala ye plata!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On no! We ticked him off, big time!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Biadam!

dialogues.speaker: Hilichurl
dialogues.text: Yaya ika! Mani ye!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, he dropped the <color=#00E1FFFF>Shield of Magnificent Honor</color> and ran!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Guys, thank you so much! I can't believe I actually found them!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Mom! Dad! Check out the legendary weapons I found!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hey, wait!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: The wine, you promised! Ugh, and I actually helped a lot this time—

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm? What're you doing here, Stanley? Out for a stroll?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Ah... haha, ah— hey...! What're you doing here, bard! Fancy that, huh? You, uh... out for a stroll, too?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: That's right, an after-dinner stroll to be precise. We were also helping a friend look for something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Paimon's starting to think Stanley might be a fraud...)

choices.text: (I'm seriously starting to think so, too.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Did Stanley plant the sword and shield here in advance so as to not hurt Jack's feelings?)

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Adventurers must be pretty familiar with Dadaupa Gorge? You've fought battles here before, after all.

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: You'd better believe it! I could navigate this whole area with my eyes closed!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Wow. Then I admire your perseverance, and your memory too.

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: It's only to be expected of a great adventurer like me! You guys had better watch out though. This place is crawling with hilichurls!

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: I, ah— I'll get back to my, um... ah... stroll now. Goodbye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guilty conscience, much?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Well, he shouldn't have gotten so carried away bragging to Jack, should he?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Although... on further reflection, I must say I'm intrigued.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Someone who can't let go of the past, and gives up on the present instead...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I wonder... if such a person was forced to take their first step towards the future, which way would they go?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you talking about?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Haha, I'm just musing to myself.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, I propose we take a trip to <color=#00E1FFFF>Angel's Share</color> tonight.

choices.text: (He's definitely a fraud. No question.)
